(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section comprising an open rib structure that is reinforced by at least one closed rib; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, wherein said body panel includes an arrangement of structural ribs that enhances the integrity of the belly pan. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a composite material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with greater than 30% long glass fibers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3 mm.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2 mm.
